title: introduce-decommit-ramp-prober-and-util-drift-auditor
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add new decommit probing controller and utilization drift auditor; backward compatible; runtime flag gated; telemetry metrics added.
description: Context: Dedicated fleets observed noisy decommits during contraction when bursty tenants oscillate across windows, causing transient SLO slippage and autoscaler churn. This PR adds two coordinated subsystems: a Decommit Ramp Prober and a Utilization Drift Auditor. The Decommit Ramp Prober issues a short-lived probing lease when a node/pool is a decommit candidate; probes follow a probe->confirm->commit lifecycle and are parametrized by ramp_duration, confirm_threshold and grace_backoff. While probing, slots are marked non-allocatable for new committed reservations but remain eligible for opportunistic backfill. The Utilization Drift Auditor wraps the existing sampler to compute compact drift statistics per-pool and per-tenant (util_drift_1m, util_drift_5m, sustained_underutil_pct, burst_imbalance_index) and surfaces anomalies to the autoscaler and SLO pipelines. Implementation: controller implemented in pkg/controller/decommit_prober.go integrating with leasebook and warmpool; auditor implemented in pkg/telemetry/util_drift_auditor.go using size-limited ring samplers with an optional persistence hook; small enum addition in pkg/leasebook/lease_state.go; runtime flag decommit_ramp_v2 gates behavior with conservative defaults and safety limits that disable on clusters with fewer than five nodes. Tests: unit tests for controller and auditor, randomized flag-toggle test, and an e2e smoke scenario simulating oscillating burst traffic asserting no >3% sustained SLO breach post scale-down. Telemetry: emits util_drift_1m_gauge, util_drift_5m_gauge, probe_outcome_counter{success,abort,timed_out}, probe_latency_histogram; includes dashboard templates and recommended alert thresholds in docs. Rollout: feature-flagged rollout plan starting with canary pools in us-west-2 for 48h then staged to 20% fleet before full rollout; backout by disabling decommit_ramp_v2. Safety notes: memory budgeted ring buffers with per-pool caps and eviction; probes abort cleanly on flag disable. Checklist: unit tests, e2e smoke, docs, telemetry, feature gate, rollout notes included.
commits: initial prober controller skeleton and lease enum
review_conversation: Diego Morales (reviewer): This is a thoughtful approach to reduce churn but I'm worried about the memory impact of per-tenant ring buffers at large scale; can we bound memory per-pool?

Maya Chen (author): Good catch - auditor uses a size-limited ring per-tenant and we added a global memory budget with eviction; added notes in util_drift_auditor.go and documented limits in docs/telemetry/util-drift.md
Fatima Alvi (reviewer): Tests look strong; please add a small randomized test that toggles the flag mid-run to verify graceful fallback
Maya Chen (author): Added randomized flag-toggle scenario in decommit_prober_test.go and validated behavior; pushed fix to ensure probes are aborted cleanly on disable
Luca Romano (approver): LGTM once CI is green and the e2e flake is addressed
CI System: All checks passed after second run, e2e timeout fixed by increasing probe wait heuristic
